{{Quote|Through the Force I can make my simple staff more powerful than ''any'' lightsaber.|Vodo-Siosk Baas|<ref name="DLOTSA" />}}
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] carried a '''wooden quarterstaff''' that offered support to his aged physical being. When the need for combat arose, Master Baas [[Force weapon|imbued]] his [[Staff/Legends|staff]] with the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], whereupon the cane served him in place of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

In [[3997 BBY]], Master Baas' staff was broken while sparring with one of his [[Padawan/Legends|students]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. Baas repaired his walking stick, but forewent using it in combat for a time. Exar Kun would later go on to become a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and instigate the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] where he committed countless atrocities against the citizens of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was then that Vodo-Siosk Baas chose to take up his staff again in preparation for an encounter with the former student whose fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] Baas felt responsible for.

The [[Krevaaki]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] confronted Kun on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and engaged him in a [[Duel in the Senate|duel]]. However, when the Dark Lord ignited the second blade of [[Exar Kun's lightsaber/Legends|his recently redesigned lightsaber]], Master Baas' staff was unable to withstand repeated blows from Kun's [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed weapon]]. The wooden staff was shattered yet again, and the cleaving strike followed through to [[Death/Legends|slay]] its owner as well.

==Description==
{{Quote|My lightsaber against your wooden stick? Haha!|Exar Kun|<ref name="DLOTSA" />}}
[[File:StickVsSaber-TOTJDLOTS1.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Baas using his staff to parry a lightsaber.]]

The walking staff that was utilized by [[Krevaaki]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]]' was simply a wooden stick approximately one and a half [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long. One end of the staff was wrapped with fabric strips and served as the head. Baas wielded the weapon in lieu of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] despite his skills in their construction, [[Force weapon|augmented]] the staff through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to allow it to withstand lightsabers, as well as transfer tremendous amounts of kinetic energy into targets, allowing him to shatter rocks with the weapon, or off-balance and disarm opponents with ease.<ref name="DLotS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Hmm&hellip;a ''mighty'' Jedi&hellip;''two'' lightsabers against my poor ''stick''.|Vodo-Siosk Baas|<ref name="DLOTS1" />}}
One of the most notable uses of the weapon was during a sparring match with Baas' student, [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. Kun, after a match with his fellow student, [[Sylvar]], suddenly fell into a vicious rage after the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] clawed him across the face in response to a speciesist slur he made against her. Were it not for Baas' intervention, Kun almost certainly would have killed her.<ref name="DLotS" />

[[File:KunVsBaas.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The staff is shattered by [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] for the first time during his lightsaber training.]]

In his arrogance, Kun challenged Baas to a sparring match, his lightsaber against his master's staff. Initially, Baas held the advantage in their contest, throwing Kun off balance with a well placed strike. However, Kun was hardly finished, summoning the lightsaber of Baas' third student, [[Crado]]. Now armed with [[Jar'Kai/Legends|two lightsabers]], Kun began raining vicious attacks upon his master, driving him back. Their contest finally ended when Kun shattered Baas' staff with a powerful dual-overhand strike. Baas casually inspected the two halves of his broken staff, lamenting Kun's usage of dual-blades against his "poor stick". He acknowledged Kun as his most formidable student, but warned of an emptiness in Kun's heart that could allow him to fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="DLotS" />

Kun left Baas' apprenticeship to seek out forbidden dark side knowledge, taking the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] without any formal basis or approval.<ref name="DLotS" />

Baas eventually took up a second staff to replace the broken one, but kept the pieces of his shattered weapon. As the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] was started by Exar Kun, who resurfaced as the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Baas considered this conflict his fault, a result of his failure to stop Kun when it mattered most. After aiding the Jedi on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in capturing Kun's apprentice, the fallen Jedi [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], Baas returned to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and resolved to find a way to stop Kun. Gathering the broken pieces of his staff, he mended the weapon and returned to Coruscant to attend Qel-Droma's [[Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma|trial]].<ref name="TSW3" />

During the trial, Qel-Droma was sentenced to death by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. However, before the sentence could be carried out, Exar Kun burst in on the proceedings, [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|paralyzing]] the Senate with a [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith spell]] and killing [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Sidrona]]. As Kun prepared to leave, Baas confronted him, wielding his mended staff. Both attempted to convince the other to join their respective causes, but were unsuccessful, and Kun drew his lightsaber.<ref name="TSW3" />

[[File:ExarKillsVodo-TOTJTSW3.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The staff is shattered for the second and last time.]]

As they battled, Baas held off his former student, constantly pleading for Kun to see reason. Tired of his masters begging, Kun decided to take their contest up a notch, igniting the second blade of his weapon, revealing it to be a double-bladed lightsaber. Unable to stand against this unfamiliar weapon, Baas was slain, his staff again shattered by a vicious overhand strike.<ref name="TSW3" />

Vodo-Siosk Baas became one with the Force, while his newly-broken staff was abandoned along with his garments.<ref name="TSW3" />
